bundle.shortDescription: CorpusMind Lens — local-first visual & multimodal corpus analysis.
bundle.longDescription: CorpusMind Lens turns sets of images into publication-ready, statistically grounded, framework-lensed discourse analysis. Own repository, own identity, own release cycle — interoperating with CorpusMind (Text) only through an optional, versioned Companion Mode API. Runs entirely locally against a local Ollama or LM Studio instance with zero cloud calls by default.
